title: Care Setting Acuity Flow Diagram
description: Trace one encounter from emergency department triage to discharge, watching the admit branch and the boarding-time edge property change with acuity.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: emergency department
inpatient care
capacity management
triage acuity
healthcare operations

educational.audience: Undergraduate students and healthcare data practitioners
learningObjectives: Given a patient's triage acuity level and the resulting admit decision, the learner can differentiate Emergency Department care from Inpatient Care by tracing the decision path and examining how boarding time reflects capacity strain.
